mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, COALESCE(MAX(c.name), '미배정 반') AS className, COALESCE(MAX(c.target_grade), '중2') AS schoolGrade, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ea.total_score), 1), 0.0) AS recentAverageScore, 96.0 AS attendanceRate FROM users u LEFT JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON u.user_id = ea.student_id WHERE u.user_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.exam_id AS examId, e.title AS examTitle, COALESCE(e.exam_round, 1) AS examRound, ea.total_score AS studentScore, ea.max_score AS maxScore, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(ea_all.total_score), 1) FROM exam_attempts ea_all WHERE ea_all.exam_id = e.exam_id ) AS classAverageScore, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS examDate FROM exam_attempts ea JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.exam_date ASC, e.exam_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(eq.large_category, '기타') AS tag,
ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS studentScoreRate,
ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS classAvgScoreRate
FROM exam_answers eans JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId}
GROUP BY COALESCE(eq.large_category, '기타')

SELECT e.title AS examTitle,
COALESCE( eq.large_category, '일반' ) AS largeCategory,
COALESCE( eq.small_category, '기본' ) AS smallCategory,
ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS studentScoreRate
FROM exam_answers eans
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id
JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId}
GROUP BY e.title, COALESCE(eq.large_category, '일반'), COALESCE(eq.small_category, '기본')

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( large_category, '기타' ) AS largeCategory,
COALESCE( small_category, '기본' ) AS smallCategory
FROM exam_questions
WHERE large_category IS NOT NULL OR small_category IS NOT NULL

SELECT e.title AS examTitle,
DATE_FORMAT( e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS examDate,
ROUND( AVG(ea.total_score), 1 ) AS classAverageScore,
( SELECT ROUND( AVG(ea_all.total_score), 1 ) FROM exam_attempts ea_all WHERE ea_all.exam_id = e.exam_id ) AS totalAverageScore
FROM classes c
JOIN class_students cs ON c.class_id = cs.class_id
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON cs.student_id = ea.student_id
JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE c.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY e.exam_id, e.title, e.exam_date
HAVING COUNT(ea.attempt_id) > 0
ORDER BY e.exam_date ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName,
ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(eans.answer_id), 0), 1 ) AS errorRate
FROM class_students cs
JOIN users u ON cs.student_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON u.user_id = ea.student_id
LEFT JOIN exam_answers eans ON ea.attempt_id = eans.attempt_id
WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name
HAVING COUNT(eans.answer_id) > 0
ORDER BY errorRate DESC

SELECT eq.question_text AS weakWord
FROM exam_answers eans
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND eans.is_correct = 0
GROUP BY eq.question_text
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE( eq.small_category, '기본' ) AS weakType
FROM exam_answers eans
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND eans.is_correct = 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(eq.small_category, '기본')
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COALESCE( eq.large_category, '일반' ) AS largeCategory,
COALESCE( eq.small_category, '기본' ) AS smallCategory,
ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(eans.answer_id), 0), 1 ) AS studentScoreRate
FROM class_students cs
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON cs.student_id = ea.student_id
JOIN exam_answers eans ON ea.attempt_id = eans.attempt_id
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id
WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY COALESCE(eq.large_category, '일반'), COALESCE(eq.small_category, '기본')
ORDER BY studentScoreRate DESC
LIMIT 3
